answer: Sensorimotor Liveness Challenge. Each identity must return a live, randomized physical task through its own hardware at unpredictable intervals: tilt a device, trace a shape, move through a space. A nebula of precomputed answers cannot cover it because the challenge depends on fresh sensor streams from one body. Operators must dedicate a separate physical unit and human presence per identity. That meadow of idle clones collapses. At dawn each node re-proves itself, so an attacker pays one device plus continuous attention per identity.
